## How it works

1. We post a public dataset and a target metric (e.g. *Wh/kg at 1C, after 500 cycles, full-cell, pack-aware*).
2. The community submits methods and results during an 8-week window.
3. AtomAgent verifies every submission against the bench.
4. The top three results receive prize money and a fast-tracked AtomPub paper.
